g.text: DON’T BE FOOLED BY THE WAY I LOOK
I DON’T WANNA FOLLOW THOSE LIGHTS I SEE OUT ON THE SHORE
THEN THE SUN STARTS TO WAKE,
IS THE SAND BY THE ROCKS IN THE SEA
BUT YOU'RE ON FIRE AND I'M A GHOST
